name: Qonto
description: Qonto lets agents read business accounts, balances, cards, and transactions, and act on Qonto data within the permissions of the signed-in user. Each user signs in to their own Qonto account through the browser.

prompts.text: What is the balance of each of my Qonto accounts?
List last month's card transactions that have no receipt.
Summarize our spending by category this quarter.

apps.name: Qonto
apps.description: Accounts, cards, and transactions, over Qonto's MCP server with browser sign-in.
